pages.text: Right-click a glyph with any item or an empty hand to open its settings.$(br2)Shift-click inventory items or drop ingredients from EMI/JEI onto the translucent filter area. Normal clicks pick up and place stacks. Clicking the filter area with a carried stack copies it without consumption.$(br2)Changes save automatically. Right-click a filter to remove it.

pages.title: Automatic saves
pages.text: Settings save as you edit. Each glyph keeps its own values.

Filled containers select their fluid. EMI/JEI also accept fluid drops.$(br2)Left-click an item filter to toggle exact data, marked $(bold)=$(). Inventory samples capture their data.$(br2)Whitelist accepts matches. Blacklist rejects matches. Priority sits below the grid; right-click filters to remove them.
pages.title: Choose ingredients
Inventory filters
pages.text: BNS supplies its inventory browser and astral sidebar when installed.

$(bold)Keep at source$() reserves stock; $(bold)Stop at target$() caps it. $(bold)-1$() is unlimited. Scroll up to 0, then 1. Fluid counts use mB.$(br2)Scroll numbers by 1; Shift changes 10, Ctrl 100, both 1,000. The Nexus quantity works the same way.$(br2)Hold Shift over a glyph for icons and amounts. Jade shows them if installed.
pages.title: Limits and inspection
Inspect with Shift
pages.text: Direction, target, filters, and configured amounts.

pages.title: Cadence
pages.text: Push/Pull runes have an $(bold)Cadence$() button. Set a batch amount and interval for each supported resource: items, fluid mB, energy FE, or Source.$(br2)Zero amount stops that resource. $(bold)Server defaults$() restores the server values. Changes save automatically, including in presets.
